findings.title: Documented beforeCompaction memory writes invalidate reused frame
findings.observed: run and stream reject CONTEXT_COMPACTION_STALE after the lifecycle hook saves EXACT_FACT to in_context_memory; zero native/main calls. Same hook succeeds under algorithmic; native unchanged-hook control succeeds.

findings.title: Native source proof reads ignore cancellation and ModelTask deadline
findings.observed: After a successful compact, block evidence.readRecord. Host cancellation or manual signal leaves operation pending after 50 ms. A 30 ms ModelTask deadline aborts the task but run remains pending after 70 ms. The active slot rejects another run. Operations reject only after read is manually released; no extra model call is sent.

findings.title: Anthropic native path silently omits unsupported top-level reasoning
findings.observed: Public addAssistantResponse accepts reasoning between text messages. Native count and compact accept it but actual installed Anthropic SDK requests contain neither its summary nor opaque content. compactContext commits a continuation and removes the reasoning from active history. Exact archived source remains available; this does not prove unrecoverable archival loss.
